diffs.diff: pin count: part has 9 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2), datasheet reading has 14 (VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2 SCX SDX CS DO GND)
diffs.evidence: Adafruit #4692 silkscreen shows two separate headers: main 9-pin row 'VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA DO CS I1 I2' and a separate 5-pin top row 'SCX SDX CS DO GND'. Adafruit guide: 'SCX, SDX, Aux CS, DO (Top) - Pins for advanced users to connect the ... LSM6DSO32 to another sensor.' The model's 9 pins exactly match the main header (footprint PinHeader_1x09) and its description explicitly states the 5-pin auxiliary SCX/SDX/CS/DO/GND header is not modelled; the second reading merged both headers (note its duplicate CS/DO/GND names). No modelled pin is wrong.

diffs.diff: acceleration (mg, +/-4 g range): datasheet reading gives 0.122 per count, the part's model has 0.003906, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000122, 0.000122, 0.000122
diffs.evidence: ST lsm6dso32_reg.c: 'float_t lsm6dso32_from_fs4_to_mg(int16_t lsb) { return ((float_t)lsb) * 0.122f; }'. The model's accel measures (0x28/0x2A/0x2C) use 0.000122 g/LSB and the driver uses 0.122e-3 g/LSB at +/-4 g = 0.122 mg/LSB: same value, different unit (g vs mg). The other listed values are temperature (1/256 degC) and gyro channels.

diffs.diff: angular rate (mdps, +/-2000 dps range): datasheet reading gives 70 per count, the part's model has 0.003906, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.00875, 0.000122, 0.000122, 0.000122
diffs.evidence: ST lsm6dso32_reg.c: 'float_t lsm6dso32_from_fs2000_to_mdps(int16_t lsb) { return ((float_t)lsb) * 70.0f; }'. The driver's table has 2000: (0b110, 70e-3) dps/LSB = 70 mdps/LSB. The sim models the +/-250 dps range the driver configures by default (0.00875 dps/LSB = 8.75 mdps/LSB, matching ST lsm6dso32_from_fs250_to_mdps * 8.75f), so the different number reflects a different full-scale range and unit, not an error.
